title: Chic Music City Hideaway, Deck, Pool & Gym Access
description:
Stay in a chic one-bedroom Illume condo for up to six guests. The bedroom has two double beds, and the living area has one queen bed. Enjoy a large furnished outdoor space, full kitchen, TVs and sound system, in-building laundry, gym, elevator, seasonal communal pool, and parking. The Gulch and downtown Nashville are nearby.

The space
Illume 407 is a one-bedroom condo for up to six guests. The bedroom has two double beds, and the living area has one queen bed. The home includes one full bathroom, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, TVs, a sound system, a full kitchen, and a large furnished outdoor space. The washer and dryer are located in the building. Shared building amenities include an elevator, gym, seasonal communal outdoor pool, landscaped courtyard, and parking. The property is close to The Gulch, downtown Nashville, museums, shopping, dining, nightlife, Bridgestone Arena, and Nissan Stadium. Check-in is after 4:00 PM and checkout is before 10:00 AM.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
